verses.greek: Ὅθεν, ἀδελφοὶ ἅγιοι, κλήσεως ἐπουρανίου μέτοχοι, κατανοήσατε τὸν ἀπόστολον καὶ ἀρχιερέα τῆς ὁμολογίας ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,
verses.literal: Therefore brothers holy of the calling heavenly partakers do carefully consider the apostle and high priest of the confession of us Jesus
verses.dgt: Therefore, holy brothers and sisters, sharers in a heavenly calling, consider Jesus, the apostle and high priest of our confession,

verses.greek: πιστὸν ὄντα τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτὸν ὡς καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: faithful being to the One having appointed Him as also Moses in the house of Him.
verses.dgt: who was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses also was in all his house.

verses.greek: πλείονος γὰρ οὗτος δόξης παρὰ Μωϋσῆν ἠξίωται καθʼ ὅσον πλείονα τιμὴν ἔχει τοῦ οἴκου ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτόν·
verses.literal: Of greater for He glory than Moses has been counted worthy by so much as greater honor has than the house itself the one having built it
verses.dgt: For he has been considered worthy of more glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has more honor than the house.

verses.greek: πᾶς γὰρ οἶκος κατασκευάζεται ὑπό τινος, ὁ δὲ πάντα κατασκευάσας θεός.
verses.literal: Every for house is built by someone the One however everything having built is God.
verses.dgt: For every house is built by someone, but the one who built all things is God.

verses.greek: καὶ Μωϋσῆς μὲν πιστὸς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ὡς θεράπων εἰς μαρτύριον τῶν λαληθησομένων,
verses.literal: And Moses indeed was faithful in all the house of Him as a servant unto a testimony of the things to be spoken
verses.dgt: And Moses was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony to the things that would be spoken,

verses.greek: Χριστὸς δὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ· ὃς οἶκός ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς, ἐὰν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ καύχημα τῆς ἐλπίδος κατάσχωμεν.
verses.literal: Christ however as the Son over the house of Him whose house are we ourselves ἐὰν the our confidence and the boast the of our hope we may hold.
verses.dgt: but Christ as a Son over his house. And we are his house, if indeed we hold firmly to our confidence and the boast of our hope.

verses.greek: Διό, καθὼς λέγει τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον· Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε,
verses.literal: Therefore even as says the Spirit the Holy: Today if the voice of Him you shall hear
verses.dgt: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, “Today, if you hear his voice,

verses.greek: μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ, κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ,
verses.literal: not shall harden the hearts of you as in the rebellion in the day the of testing in the wilderness
verses.dgt: do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, on the day of testing in the wilderness,

verses.greek: οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν δοκιμασίᾳ καὶ εἶδον τὰ ἔργα μου
verses.literal: where tried the fathers of you by testing and saw the works of Mine
verses.dgt: where your fathers tested me by trial and saw my works

verses.greek: τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη· διὸ προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ καὶ εἶπον· Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ· αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου·
verses.literal: forty years 10 Therefore I was angry with the generation that and I said Always they go astray in the heart they themselves and not have they known the ways of Mine
verses.dgt: for forty years. Therefore I was angry with that generation and said, ‘They always go astray in their heart, and they have not known my ways.’

verses.greek: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου· Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.
verses.literal: so I swore in the wrath of Mine not will they enter into the rest of Mine.
verses.dgt: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will certainly not enter my rest.’”

verses.greek: βλέπετε, ἀδελφοί, μήποτε ἔσται ἔν τινι ὑμῶν καρδία πονηρὰ ἀπιστίας ἐν τῷ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ζῶντος,
verses.literal: do take heed brothers otherwise there will be in any of you a heart evil of unbelief into the falling away from God the living
verses.dgt: Watch out, brothers and sisters, lest there ever be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief in falling away from the living God,

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθʼ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν, ἄχρις οὗ τὸ Σήμερον καλεῖται, ἵνα μὴ σκληρυνθῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ἀπάτῃ τῆς ἁμαρτίας·
verses.literal: But do encourage each other each every day while this the today it is called so that not may be hardened one of you by the deceitfulness the of sin
verses.dgt: but encourage one another every day, as long as it is called “Today,” so that none of you may be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

verses.greek: μέτοχοι γὰρ τοῦ Χριστοῦ γεγόναμεν, ἐάνπερ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ὑποστάσεως μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν.
verses.literal: Partakers for the of Christ we have become if indeed from the beginning of the assurance unto the end firm we shall hold
verses.dgt: For we have become sharers in Christ, if indeed we hold firm to the beginning of our confidence until the end,

verses.greek: ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαι· Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, Μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ.
verses.literal: As the saying: Today if the voice of Him you shall hear not shall harden the hearts of you as in the rebellion.
verses.dgt: while it is said, “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion.”

verses.greek: τίνες γὰρ ἀκούσαντες παρεπίκραναν; ἀλλʼ οὐ πάντες οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου διὰ Μωϋσέως;
verses.literal: Who for were those having heard rebelled? but surely all those having come out of Egypt through Moses?
verses.dgt: For who heard and rebelled? Was it not all those who came out of Egypt through Moses?

verses.greek: τίσιν δὲ προσώχθισεν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη; οὐχὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτήσασιν, ὧν τὰ κῶλα ἔπεσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ;
verses.literal: With whom now was He indignant forty years? Surely with those having sinned whose the bodies fell in the wilderness?
verses.dgt: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

verses.greek: τίσιν δὲ ὤμοσεν μὴ εἰσελεύσεσθαι εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν;
verses.literal: To whom then did He swear that not to enter into the rest of Him only except to those having disobeyed?
verses.dgt: And to whom did he swear that they would not enter his rest, except to those who disobeyed?

verses.greek: καὶ βλέπομεν ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν εἰσελθεῖν διʼ ἀπιστίαν.
verses.literal: And we see that not they were able to enter in because of unbelief.
verses.dgt: And we see that they were unable to enter because of unbelief.
